metric.name: qualifying_income
metric.description: Qualifying income for a lending package: the sum of W-2 Box 1 (Wages, tips, other compensation) for the latest tax year, per borrower, summed across the package's borrowers. Payslips and bank deposits corroborate and are never added. Governs fin:QualifyingIncome (operand concept fin:W2WagesBox1). Owner: COM305 lending data steward. Effective from 2026-11-11. Demo data is fictitious.

dialects.expression: SELECT CAST(SUM(w.amount_box1) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS qualifying_income FROM com305_coa_spike_lending.w2_box1 w WHERE w.package_id = :package_id AND w.tax_year = (SELECT MAX(x.tax_year) FROM com305_coa_spike_lending.w2_box1 x WHERE x.package_id = w.package_id AND x.borrower = w.borrower)

metric.label: Qualifying income

synonyms: total income for a lending package
aiContext.instructions: Bind package_id via options.dimensions and call with tierOverride 1. Latest tax year is chosen per borrower inside the SQL.
